note: Ceilings for the CI perf gate (scripts/perf-budget-check.mjs), checked against the median of 3 runs on a GitHub runner. They sit between the current numbers (baseline.json, measured on Apple Silicon: dragPanel 1 long task / ~100 ms) and the pre-optimisation numbers (dragPanel 38 long tasks / ~2.6 s), so noise on a slower runner does not trip them but losing the drag hot-path work does. Tighten only with measurements from a runner, not a laptop.
